schema._comment: Each entry represents one card published in one issue. topicKey is the stable slug used for dedup checks — when the same topic appears across issues (e.g., Spring Payroll Promo in #10 and #11), they share a topicKey so the skill can see the topic's history and decide whether a Week-N candidate represents further evolution worth covering again.

fields.issueDate: Date string YYYY-MM-DD — the 'Week of' date from the issue badge
fields.department: Section the card lived in: 'CS Ops', 'PMM', 'LCM', 'RevOps', or 'Product'
fields.title: The card's <h2> title
fields.topicKey: Stable kebab-case slug. Same topic across issues = same topicKey.
fields.cardAnchor: The card's id attribute (e.g., 'card-payrollpromo'), useful for cross-referencing the archived HTML
fields.summary: 1-2 sentence summary of what was covered, for quick dedup reasoning

covered.title: Cash Out Employee FAQ Page — Live Now
covered.summary: New public employee-facing Cash Out FAQ page at joinhomebase.com/faq-cashout. Replaces long support-article handoffs and will be used in Cash Out email links going forward.

covered.title: Break Management Awareness Push — Goes Live May 26
covered.summary: Newsletter feature and in-app nudge go live May 26 for Plus/AiO owners with Break Management auto-enabled. Basic/Essentials upsell motion remains in planning.

covered.title: TLWA Hiring Assistant Reminder Campaigns — Launched May 21
covered.summary: LCM launched reminder touchpoints for TLWA winners who have not scanned their QR code, converting award interest into Hiring Assistant activation.

covered.title: Blitz Beta Cadences
covered.summary: Blitz Beta moved to two auto-routed 5-day cadences with manual calls, automated SMS/email, Day 5 breakup SMS, built-in right-panel talk tracks, carryover protections, and Product Family shown on past opps.

covered.title: Spring Payroll Promo — Wave 2 Hits Existing Customers May 19
covered.summary: Wave 2 extends 3 months free on Payroll to existing customers via in-app + email starting May 19. Campaign live through July 15, 2026. Goals: ~6.2K opps, $165K new MRR, 90% M4+ retention. Auto-applied from May 19; manual exception adds for May 11–19 use package 39/6. Includes Loom walkthrough by Pablo Tac on common exception cases. (Continuation of #10 banner + #11 launch.)

covered.title: Time-Saving Proof Points — Sales-Ready Stats
covered.summary: First wave of customer-backed proof points from the platform time-savings survey: scheduling 90→30 min, payroll 60→15 min (both stat-sig), and 82% say HB makes running their business less stressful. Full library shareout this week.

covered.title: "Clocked In" Monthly Release Email Launches May 19
covered.summary: New monthly product update email to all active customers, launching 5/19. Two sections: Quality & Reliability and What's New. Designed to build trust and improve NPS through a transparent product rhythm.

covered.title: Cash Out Discover Cards: Real Adoption + SMS Experiment Live
covered.summary: Week 1 of Discover acceptance: 140+ Discover cards linked, 14+ advances processed. SMS web enrollment experiment now live to ~5K employees, going out after scheduled shift clock-outs. One known D4 KYC edge case — escalate to Elizabeth Beaty. (Continuation of #11 Discover unblock.)

covered.title: Blitz Mode Beta Wrapping — Broader Launch Next Week
covered.summary: Trailblazer team's Blitz Mode beta in GTM OS wrapping this week, broader rollout to sales the following week. Training day/time TBD.

covered.title: New Hire Packet — "Overdue" Logic Now Live
covered.summary: Employee-side onboarding card now flips to 'Overdue' when an EE's start date passes without NHP completion. Triggered by start date, not invite date. No employer notifications or penalty yet.

covered.title: Cash Out Now Accepts Discover Cards
covered.summary: Lifting the block on Discover Debit (primary issuer for Capital One Bank). Was costing ~620 new Cash Out enrollments/month. Web enrollment rolling out now; SMS invites next week.

covered.title: 3 Months Free Payroll — Spring Promo is Live
covered.summary: Spring Payroll Promo live May 11 for net-new, May 19 for existing customers. Offer ends July 15, 2026. Auto-applied at signup; manual exception handling in the gap week (May 11–19) using package 39/6. (Continuation of #10 coverage; banner went live in #10, full launch in #11.)

covered.title: New Left-Hand Navigation — Rollout Continues
covered.summary: Phase 1 live to 50% of newly created web accounts (leftnav_simplification staging). Cleaner labels and simplified sub-nav. Phase 2 to existing customers planned for May 2026.

covered.title: In-App Sales Call / "Call Us" Experiment — Payroll Setup
covered.summary: Proactive live-specialist widget surfaces during Payroll Setup flow. Three progressive states from seeing availability to receiving a live call without leaving the app.

covered.title: Hiring V1 → V2 Migration: In-App Switch Surfaces
covered.summary: Two in-app surfaces moving legacy Hiring V1 customers to the new AI-powered V2. Segment-driven CTAs: self-serve gets one-click switch, sales-led routes to a specialist. Job posts, candidates, and history transfer automatically.

covered.title: New Stage-Based Cadences — Live for Switchers
covered.summary: GTM OS cadences redesigned around 21-day opp lifecycle for the Switcher team. Every stage (New, Connect, Consult, Closing) gets its own 21-day cadence that restarts when an opp enters that stage.

covered.title: New Auto-Close Rules — Live Now
covered.summary: Full Payroll team (not just Switchers) now auto-closes lost opps when 3 conditions are met simultaneously: 21+ days old, 7+ days stuck in stage, no future Calendly meeting booked. Close date field removed from logic. Cleanup window April 29–May 1, 2026; auto-close batch ran May 4.

covered.title: Spring Payroll Promo — In-App Banner Live
covered.summary: In-app banner rolling out in two waves driving Payroll + Plus upgrades. Two CTAs: 'Get deal' (direct upgrade) and 'Book a demo' (scheduling). Foundational announcement before the full promo went live in #11.
